title: Input validation
problem: External inputs can violate type, size, path or business constraints.
rationale: New/changed external inputs require the mapping and independent assessment before merge.
applicability: New or changed external inputs and business trust boundaries.
baseline_policy: No legacy waiver for required verification or release prerequisites.
